## Who develops MOVES Utilities

The Texas A&M Transportation Institute (TTI) develops MOVES Utilities with sponsorship from the Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT).

Release text on this site is reviewed and approved by the MOVES Utilities project team at the Texas A&M Transportation Institute before it is published.

## Contact

- Questions and problem reports: open an issue in the [moves-utilities repository]({{< var contact.url >}}). You need a GitHub account.

## Disclaimer

MOVES Utilities is not a product of the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA). EPA has not reviewed or endorsed it. MOVES is developed and distributed by EPA.

The use of MOVES results for State Implementation Plans and transportation conformity is governed by EPA policy and technical guidance. You are responsible for checking that your analysis meets that guidance.

The contents of this site do not necessarily reflect the official views or policies of TxDOT.

The software is provided as is, without warranty.

## Privacy

This site does not use analytics or cookies.

This site is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub may log standard server data, such as visitor IP addresses, as described in the [GitHub Privacy Statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement).

## Accessibility

TTI aims for this site to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1, Level AA.

If you have trouble using any part of this site, open an issue in the [moves-utilities repository]({{< var contact.url >}}). Tell us the page address and the problem.

See also the Texas A&M University System regulation [29.01.04, Accessibility of Digital Resources](https://policies.tamus.edu/29-01-04.pdf).
